prompt: As global trade increases, many goods including those we use on daily basis are produced in another country and have to be transported long distances . Do benefits of this trend outweigh disadvantages
essay:
It has become increasingly common for regularly used items to be transported from one part of the world to another through international trade. Although this development offers certain benefits, I believe the disadvantages outweigh the advantages, primarily because it leads to environmental degradation and increased competition for local businesses.

One drawback of this trend is that it contributes to environmental pollution. This is because transportation over long distances consumes large amounts of non-renewable energy resources. As a result, it leads to the depletion of these limited resources and also releases pollutants into the air, leading to air pollution. Consequently, it can cause health issues and reduce the availability of non-renewable resources. For example, a big truck needs diesel to travel. Transporting goods requires either road or air transportation, both of which require fuel to operate. Long distances mean greater fuel consumption.

On the other hand, I believe that one advantage of importing goods from other countries is that it increases their availability to people. The primary reason is that a variety of everyday goods will be easily available. This is because of their importation. For example, even though fresh produce is grown in Canada, the importation of fresh fruits and vegetables from other countries will increase their supply and reduce their cost.

In conclusion, although there is a benefit in terms of the availability of regularly used items, I believe that the disadvantages of importing items outweigh the advantages because it can degrade the environment and deplete non-renewable energy resources
